name: Ticket Enrichment + Remediation — AI-Driven Incident Response
description: Extends the enrichment workflow with automated remediation. Gathers diagnostics, performs AI root cause analysis, then an AI agent discovers the appropriate AAP job template to fix the issue and runs it. If no suitable fix is found, the incident is updated with the analysis only. Updates the ServiceNow incident with RCA and remediation results.

incident_description.description: Combined short_description + description from the incident

extra_vars.work_notes: [AUTOMATED — Remediation Complete] The AI agent identified and executed the appropriate fix via AAP.

[AUTOMATED — No Automated Fix Available] The AI agent could not find a suitable job template to remediate this issue. Manual intervention is required. Please review the root cause analysis above for remediation guidance.
